question: In evidence.zip, use the d99-- member. Submit true exactly when any DT_NEEDED entry equals libz.so.1 and no nonempty ELF symbol name contains gnat. Submit lowercase true or false.
oracle_cmd: { readelf -d -W gf_c_imports.bin | sed -n 's/.*(NEEDED).*\[\(.*\)\]/\1/p' | grep -qx libz.so.1 && ! readelf -sW gf_c_imports.bin | awk 'NR>3{print $8}' | grep -q gnat; } && echo true || echo false
